_meta.note: Festival dates are pre-computed for Varanasi (IST). Within India these dates are essentially universal; elsewhere (EU / North America / rest of world) festivals can shift by ±1 day — build a location-specific table at runtime with buildFestivalsTable and cache it. Eclipses are excluded because visibility is location-dependent; use getUpcomingEclipses. Each entry carries both en and hi text (names and descriptions).
